classification_contract.PHYSICAL_ELIGIBLE: ordinary three-field row in 21-bit address and 12-bit XY ranges
classification_contract.PHYSICAL_NO_ADDRESS: ordinary two-field XY row without candidate address
classification_contract.STRICT_SERVICE: 03:03:03 all-zero singleton, three fields, leading integer > 2^21-1

prohibited_claim: A(x,y) recovery is not proprietary A->ECC-word/parity W.

INFERENCE: For ordinary three-field records, field0_raw is identified as external 21-bit byte address A with very strong empirical support; public raw documentation does not explicitly label the column.
MODEL_ASSUMPTION: Mapping class is affine GF(2) with [1,x0..x11,y0..y11].
SOURCE_SUPPORTED: CY62167GE30-45ZXI is a 16-Mbit SRAM externally organized as 2^21 x8.
Controlled literature states manufacturer logical-to-physical descrambling information was used to create campaign XY physical maps.
Exact proprietary physical-to-ECC mapping is not public.
